C1720: Cortech Chuckwagon Max Insulated Food Tray Delivery Cart
Product URL: https://www.anchortex.com/products/cortech-c1720-chuckwagon-max-tray-transport-cart
Manufacturer page: https://cortechusa.com/products/food-service/correctional-food-tray-delivery-carts/chuckwagon-max/
Spec sheet: C1720
Recommended H1 and Subtitle
H1: Cortech Chuckwagon Max Insulated Tray Delivery Cart with Stainless Steel Base – C1720
Current H1: Cortech Chuckwagon Max Tray Transport Cart with Stainless Steel Base - C1720
Subtitle: One-Piece Insulated Tray Cart on a Stainless Steel Base, with Optional Locking Hasp and Tow and Hitch
Current subtitle: Cortech USA C1720
Revised Product Description
Headings marked [H2] should be set as H2 on the page.
The Cortech Chuckwagon Max Insulated Tray Delivery Cart is the Chuckwagon on a stainless steel base, for meal delivery in prisons, jails, and other correctional facilities. It holds up to 150 Rock Trays, 120 Rock 2.0 Trays, or 108 X-Trays, and it keeps hot food hot and cold food cold on the way.
The cart has a one-piece molded cavity with no seams, no welded walls, and no adhesives, and its walls are filled with high grade insulation. The two insulated sliding doors have no hinges and lift out for cleaning. It can be ordered with a locking hasp, a tow and hitch attachment, or both.
Material: High impact polyethylene cart on a stainless steel base
Construction: One-piece molded cavity with no seams, no welded walls, and no adhesives
Insulation: Walls and doors are filled with high grade insulation to keep hot food hot and cold food cold
Dimensions: 56”L×31”W×64”H
Weight: 300 lbs
Load Capacity: 1,000 lbs
Tray Size: Holds any tray up to 9½”×14½”
Tray Capacity: 150 Rock Trays, 120 Rock 2.0 Trays, or 108 X-Trays; trays sold separately
Doors: Two one-piece insulated sliding doors with no hinges; they lift out for cleaning
Locking Hasp: Optional tamper-resistant locking door latch
Tow and Hitch: Optional tow and hitch attachment
Top Surface: Ribbed raised top surface safely holds more trays, beverage servers, and wash racks
Handles: Molded handles on all four sides
Casters: Non-marring kingpin-less casters
Bumpers: Built-in wall bumpers
Color: Brown (custom colors available on request)
Warranty: 3-year factory warranty
Country of Manufacture: USA, made to ISO quality standards
Available Models and Options
C1720 – Standard: Without locking hasp
C1720LH – With Locking Hasp: Tamper-resistant locking door latch
C1720TH – With Tow and Hitch: Tow and hitch attachment
C1720LHTH – With Locking Hasp and Tow and Hitch: Both options
Installation and Options
Assembly: Hardware bit size is T45
[H2] Applications
The Chuckwagon Max suits large facilities that want an insulated tray cart on a stainless steel base, with the option to tow it.
Typical applications include:
Meal delivery from central kitchens to housing units in prisons and jails
Detention centers and juvenile facilities
Other secure facilities that deliver meals on trays
Explore Anchortex's Prison and Detention Kitchen and Food Service Equipment collection for more food trays, delivery carts, and food service supplies.
[H2] About Cortech Food Service
Cortech food service products are made for high-volume meal service in correctional facilities, where trays, carts, and dispensers are used and washed every day. Cortech trays and delivery carts are sized to work together.
Cortech food service includes:
Insulated Food Trays: The Rock, Rock 2.0, Rock with Cor-Flex, and X-Tray, with matching lids
Tray Delivery Carts: The insulated Chuckwagon, Chuckwagon Jr., and Chuckwagon Max, and the non-insulated Tray Master
Beverage Service: The BevMax insulated beverage dispenser
Tray Drying: Aluminum meal tray drying racks
[H2] About Cortech
Cortech manufactures durable molded furniture for demanding environments, including behavioral healthcare facilities, psychiatric hospitals, correctional institutions, law enforcement facilities, and homeless and emergency shelters. Explore the full line of Cortech Behavioral Health and Prison Furniture at Anchortex.
Meta Title and Description
Meta title (63 characters): Cortech Chuckwagon Max Insulated Tray Cart - C1720 at Anchortex
Meta description (151 characters): Shop the Cortech Chuckwagon Max. A one-piece insulated food tray delivery cart on a stainless steel base, with optional locking hasp and tow and hitch.
Notes and Questions
Series section: "About Cortech Food Service" is a new section for the food service pages (trays, lids, delivery carts, BevMax, and drying racks). It is the same on each of these pages.
H1: Cortech calls it the Chuckwagon Max Insulated Food Tray Delivery Cart with Tow and Hitch. I used "Insulated Tray Delivery Cart with Stainless Steel Base" to keep your "Stainless Steel Base" and keep the H1 shorter.
Weight: your variants are set to 310 lbs. The Cortech spec sheet says 300 lbs, so I used 300 lbs.
Tray capacity: the Cortech spec sheet says 108 X-Trays, 120 Rock 2.0 Trays, or 150 Rock Trays. The Cortech web page says 102 Rock 2.0 Trays and gives "with lids" numbers lower than the Chuckwagon’s, although the two carts are the same size. I used the spec sheet numbers and left the "with lids" numbers out.
Warranty: your current page does not list a warranty. The Cortech spec sheet says 3-year factory warranty, so I added it.
Model numbers: the Cortech spec sheet lists C1720 and C1720TH, with the locking hasp as an option. I kept your four variants.
Collection link: I linked the Prison and Detention Kitchen and Food Service Equipment collection, which this product is already in.
Product images: the page has one image, whose file name says "C1718." The Cortech product page has one Chuckwagon Max photo (C1720LH). Would you like me to add it?
